scope.summary: Eleven new tables (atelier_tag_note, atelier_ckc_search_projection, atelier_sheet_field_value_projection, atelier_sheet_artifact_link, atelier_intake_item_metadata, atelier_prompt_feedback_{case,verdict,rule_pack,rewrite,export}, atelier_collection_item_unlink_receipt) plus in-place extensions of atelier_collection (created_by, updated_by, scoped_name_key stored discriminator replacing the global name UNIQUE), atelier_collection_item (source refs, linked_by, updated_by, updated_at_utc), atelier_action_receipt (thread_id, lease_claim_id). History (ALTER/backfill/DO) is not ported: bootstrap is fresh-only.
pg_to_surreal_deviations: pg_trgm / pgvector / atelier_trgm_similarity(): no schema counterpart; fuzzy and vector scoring move to Rust / SurrealQL string::similarity + vector::similarity::cosine (MT-060)
partial UNIQUE indexes -> stored discriminator fields with VALUE IF ... (scoped_name_key, active_link_key), the precedent of role_mailbox_claim_lease.active_thread_key
COALESCE(scope_ref,'') unique -> scope_ref stored as '' for the global tag note
composite PK (rule_pack_id, version) -> array record id; composite FKs -> rule_pack_ref record link asserted against the scalar columns
atelier_is_native_portable_ref() SQL -> Rust validator (MT-059) with a structural floor in ASSERT
